verdict: A very close, clean rebuild of the Wikipedia Community feed whose main gaps are a 3-4 px upward drift of the tabs, date and article card plus a slightly misregistered badge image, built as well-named flex HTML with a templated bottom nav.

top_defects.where: tabs row, date line, featured article card
top_defects.what: Community/For you labels, Today - Nov 12, 2026 and the image card (top edge ~y=1102 vs 1106 px, save/share buttons with it) sit 3-4 px higher than the reference; the Home pill sits ~2 px lower
the badge photo is scaled/offset a few px differently inside the 16 dp card, so its edges misregister everywhere (heatmap cells meanDiff 22-35 over the image area)

top_defects.where: article summary card over the image
top_defects.what: corner radius 12 dp (31 px) instead of 8 dp (21 px)
Wi-Fi and battery glyphs darker #444746 and larger than the reference's grey icons; red dots #d73333 instead of #b32424
ellipsis after a whole word, 'Cheltenham…', instead of the reference's character truncation 'Cheltenham Tr…'
135 arbitrary values (colors like #202122/#54595d/#3366cc repeated as literals, margins like mt-[13px], top-[204px]) instead of shared tokens; tabs not templated
inline style attributes (font-variation-settings) on Material Symbols spans, against the no-inline-style convention; summary panel placed at a magic top-[204px]

strengths: Every text, the wordmark, globe, badge photo, app icons and both 'new' dots are present with the right content, Roboto and Noto Serif title, and measured colors (#202122, #54595d, #3366cc, #eaecf0, #e8f0ff)
Bottom navigation built once as a data-driven template (5 items with icon, pill, label and badge variants)
Readable layer names throughout (Status bar, Tabs row, Community banner, Featured article card, Article summary, Bottom navigation) and flex layout for the flowing parts
